exceptions.reason: the repository adopts CD-6 through the audit only and does not run ESLint

whys.why: Why is CD-6#naming-convention waived across the repository?
whys.because: Its only mechanism is ESLint, and the repository runs no ESLint at all.

whys.why: Why does the repository run no ESLint?
whys.because: Its lint step is the audit mechanism alone, chosen when the project was set up.

whys.why: Why was the audit mechanism alone chosen when the project was set up?
whys.because: The team wanted one tool with no plugin configuration to keep in step.

whys.why: Why does the team want no plugin configuration to keep in step?
whys.because: Nobody on the team owns lint configuration, so a second tool would drift unreviewed.

whys.why: Why would a second tool drift unreviewed without an owner?
whys.because: Configuration changes land only when someone owns them, and no one is assigned to ESLint.

whyChain.rootCause: No one is assigned to ESLint, so its configuration changes never land, and the repository adopts CD-6 through the audit only, waiving the ESLint-only clause.
whyChain.rootCheck: disciplines.json still selects CD-6#naming-convention through eslint only to keep the discipline covered.
whyChain.readback: No one owns ESLint, therefore the repository runs none, therefore CD-6#naming-convention cannot run, therefore it is waived across the repository.
